messages.content:
You are a CRM migration engineer translating ONE Salesforce validation rule into an Airtable guard formula.

Airtable has no validation rules. The guard is a formula field that returns the text "VIOLATION" when a record
violates the business rule and "" otherwise. Use exactly this shape: IF(<condition>, "VIOLATION", "").
Inside <condition> use only: AND(), OR(), NOT(), {Field} = "text", {Field} = BLANK(), {Field} != BLANK(),
numeric comparisons (= != < <= > >=) against literals, TRUE(), FALSE(). Nothing else (no FIND, LEN, IF nesting, dates).

Field names differ between systems; map each Salesforce field to the Airtable field with the same meaning, using
only the Airtable fields listed.

Return JSON only, matching the schema. Your confidence is the probability that your guard is EXACTLY equivalent
to the Salesforce rule for every possible record.

Salesforce object: Opportunity
Rule API name: ClosedWon_Amount_Naive
Error condition formula (the rule FIRES, i.e. blocks the save, when this is TRUE):
ISPICKVAL(StageName,"Closed Won") && Amount <= 0
Error message shown to users: A Closed Won opportunity must have a positive amount.
Admin description (business intent): Finance: no deal may be booked as won with zero or negative revenue.
Active: True

Salesforce fields referenced or available:
- StageName: picklist, required options=["Prospecting", "Qualification", "Needs Analysis", "Value Proposition", "Id. Decision Makers", "Perception Analysis", "Proposal/Price Quote", "Negotiation/Review", "Closed Won", "Closed Lost"]
- Amount: currency

Airtable table "Opportunities" fields available:
- Name: text
- Stage: picklist options=["Prospecting", "Qualification", "Needs Analysis", "Value Proposition", "Id. Decision Makers", "Perception Analysis", "Proposal/Price Quote", "Negotiation/Review", "Closed Won", "Closed Lost", "Negotiation", "Proposal"]
- Amount: currency
- Probability: percent
- Discount: percent
- Loss Reason: text
- Type: picklist options=["New Customer", "Existing Customer - Upgrade", "Existing Customer - Replacement", "Existing Customer - Downgrade", "New Business", "Renewal", "Upsell"]

Produce the Airtable guard.

message.content: {"intent_statement":"Prevent an Opportunity from being marked Closed Won unless it has a positive Amount, ensuring revenue is booked accurately.","field_mapping":[{"source_field":"StageName","target_field":"Stage","target_type":"singleSelect"},{"source_field":"Amount","target_field":"Amount","target_type":"currency"}],"guard_field_name":"Guard: ClosedWon_Amount_Naive","guard_formula":"IF(AND({Stage} = \"Closed Won\", {Amount} <= 0), \"VIOLATION\", \"\")","rationale":"Directly mirrors the Salesforce rule: fires when Stage is Closed Won and Amount is zero or negative, using equivalent Airtable fields and numeric comparison.","confidence":0.95,"caveats":["Assumes Amount is never blank when Stage is Closed Won; if Amount is BLANK(), Airtable numeric comparison treats it as 0, which would still correctly trigger VIOLATION, matching Salesforce behavior where a null Amount also satisfies <=0 in most orgs.","Does not account for the extra Airtable-only Stage options 'Negotiation' and 'Proposal' since they don't correspond to 'Closed Won' and are irrelevant to this rule."]}
